177:t_1:569.en:
$$ランド$$
「To repay a debt of gratitude, huh... Not bad.」

177:t_1:570.en:
$n
「Please tell me, $$ランド$$... How can I draw out the power of the $$スフィア$$?」

177:t_1:575.en:
$$ランド$$
「Getting tossed around by a $$スフィア$$ never leads to anything good. If you want to get stronger, find another way.」

177:t_1:577.en:
$$ランド$$
「I heard from $$セツコ$$ earlier. You're having her drill piloting technique into you, right?」

177:t_1:578.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll help you out too.」

177:t_1:580.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold on, don't expect too much. Even if I help you out, all I can do is repairs and drinking.」

177:t_1:583.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll pass on what the man who looked after me taught me when I was about your age.」

177:t_1:587.en:
$$ランド$$
「What I'm going to teach you is the smile. Smile.」

177:t_1:589.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know what happened to you, and I can't fix that for you either. So I'll teach you the strength to live from here on.」

177:t_1:592.en:
$$ランド$$
「Deeper, from the bottom of your heart. Smile even when you're sad or in pain. The feelings will follow later.」

177:t_1:593.en:
$$ランド$$
「Turn everything upside down! Then you can face forward and keep going!」

177:t_1:596.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this, $n. If you're going to save me, I'll save you too.」

177:t_1:597.en:
$$ランド$$
「And just call me $$ランド$$. We're even.」

177:t_1:599.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Looks like you already learned the smile from $$ランド$$.」

177:t_1:600.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Personally, I have a few complaints, though...」

177:t_1:601.en:
$$メール$$
「I get it, I get it! Once you've mastered Darling's Heat Smile, $n, you'll be a huge hit!」

177:t_1:604.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...As long as he's happy, that's fine.」

177:t_1:605.en:
$$メール$$
「I don't really get it, but let's say everything's OK.」

177:t_1:606.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right then, $$セツコ$$. Let's start $n's special training right away. I can at least play the sparring partner.」

177:t_1:607.en:
$n
「Sorry. I appreciate the offer, but I... have something to do after this...」

177:t_1:609.en:
$n
「I hear $$アルト$$ has been having nightmares this whole time. He's resting even now.」

177:t_1:610.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that you mention it, he isn't in the hangar...」

177:t_1:611.en:
$n
「I'm going to go check on him. It's not like I can do anything, though...」

177:t_1:612.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All right, $n. Once that's settled, let's start your training.」

177:t_1:613.en:
$$ランド$$
「Go deliver a smile to $$アルト$$. Fortune comes to the house that laughs, as they say.」

177:t_1:615.en:
$n
「...Sorry. I'll drop by later, so Miss $$スズネ$$, please go on ahead.」

177:t_1:617.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$ doesn't seem to be feeling well, so I'm going to go check on him.」

177:t_1:618.en:
$n
「I hear he's been having nightmares this whole time.」

177:t_1:621.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It beats the kind of smile people call scary, like yours, $n.」

177:t_1:623.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Just kidding. That smile was because I'm happy you've changed, $n.」

177:t_1:625.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What a reaction... He must have really cared about it.)

177:t_1:627.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-well... Let's set that aside for now...」

177:t_1:630.en:
$n
「...In that case, I'll ask $$ボス$$ or $$木下$$ for special training...」

177:t_1:631.en:
$$スズネ$$
「T-that's enough...! You don't have to force yourself to change your character...!」

177:t_1:632.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What I wanted to say is something else.」

177:t_1:634.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, yes. More to the point, you're going to visit him, right?」

177:t_1:636.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's a good sign that he's started reaching out to people on his own. At this rate, getting over being sullen might not be far off.)

177:t_1:637.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But it's a little lonely that I won't be the only one he opens up to anymore...)

177:t_1:640.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-it's nothing! Say hi to $$アルト$$ for me.」

177:t_1:648.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You're always like that, $$アルト$$...」

177:t_1:649.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You always call $$シェリル$$ first... That time, and that time too...」
